name: Spring Valley
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Spring Valley, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Spring Valley, CA: Winter Fest with Santa photos, cookie decorating and letters to Santa at the Spring Valley Community Center.
lede: Spring Valley is an unincorporated community, so its big holiday party comes from San Diego County Parks: Winter Fest at the Spring Valley Community Center, with photos with Santa, cookie decorating and letters to Santa.
celebrates: Because Spring Valley has no city hall of its own, the County of San Diego Department of Parks and Recreation hosts the community's holiday party. Winter Fest fills the Spring Valley Community Center on Jamacha Boulevard with arts and crafts, games, cookie decorating, letters to Santa, live music and photos with Santa, and the county lists it as free. The Spring Valley Historical Society kicks off the season at the Bancroft Ranch House with a holiday potluck, carols and a white elephant gift exchange. Faith Chapel in Spring Valley hosts a free Community Christmas with Santa's petting zoo, a live nativity and photos with Santa.
lastyear: In 2025, San Diego County Parks invited families to Spring Valley Winter Fest on Friday, December 12, from 4 to 7 pm at the Spring Valley Community Center, 8735 Jamacha Boulevard. The county's post called it a free, festive event filled with games, arts and crafts and much more. The 2026 Winter Fest moves to Friday, December 11, and adds cookie decorating, letters to Santa, live music and photos with Santa to the county's listing.
facts: Spring Valley is named for the natural spring there. The Spanish, who used the land for cattle, called it El aguaje de San Jorge, St. George's Spring. In 1863 Judge A. S. Ensworth of San Diego claimed a 160 acre ranch around the spring and built a small adobe house, later sold to Rufus King Porter and then to historian Hubert Howe Bancroft. That adobe is now the Bancroft Ranch House Museum on Memory Lane, a California Historic Landmark and National Historic Landmark run by the Spring Valley Historical Society.
trains: Spring Valley has no trolley station of its own, but the San Diego Trolley's Orange Line runs through Lemon Grove at Massachusetts Avenue and Lemon Grove Depot and on to Spring Street and La Mesa Boulevard in La Mesa, before ending in El Cajon. From downtown San Diego, families can continue to Balboa Park and the San Diego Model Railroad Museum. For a Christmas train ride, the Pacific Southwest Railway Museum in Campo runs its popular North Pole Limited each holiday season.

kidfact: Spring Valley got its name from a real spring of water. Long ago, cattle ranchers called it St. George's Spring, and the little adobe house built beside it is now a museum you can visit.
faq: Who runs Christmas events in Spring Valley?

Spring Valley is an unincorporated community, so there is no city parks department. The County of San Diego Department of Parks and Recreation hosts Winter Fest at the Spring Valley Community Center, 8735 Jamacha Boulevard, and posts the details on its official events calendar. Local groups such as the Spring Valley Historical Society and Faith Chapel add their own holiday gatherings.
Where can kids see Santa in Spring Valley?

Winter Fest at the Spring Valley Community Center includes photos with Santa and a letters to Santa activity, and the county lists it as free and fun for the whole family. Faith Chapel's free Community Christmas also offers a picture with Santa, along with a petting zoo and a live nativity scene.
What is the Bancroft Ranch House Museum?

It is the small adobe ranch house at 9050 Memory Lane that historian Hubert Howe Bancroft once owned, now run by the Spring Valley Historical Society. It is a California Historic Landmark and a National Historic Landmark, and the society lists visiting hours on Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 1 to 4 pm.
Is there a library holiday program in Spring Valley?

The San Diego County Library runs a Spring Valley branch at 836 Kempton Street. Its calendar lists regular children's programs such as bilingual pajama storytimes and free afterschool snacks for kids. Check the library's events calendar in December for any seasonal programs before you go.
